note: Opposite of 薄; also 厚厚的 for emphasis.

examples.zh: 外面很冷，你穿厚一点。
examples.en: It's cold outside; wear something thicker.

examples.zh: 这本书太厚了，我看不完。
examples.en: This book is too thick; I can't finish it.

examples.zh: 床上有一条厚被子。
examples.en: There is a thick quilt on the bed.

meaning: curved, bent (adj.); to bend (v.); a bend

senses.en: curved, bent (adj.); to bend (v.); a bend

note: 拐弯 = turn a corner; 弯腰 = bend over.

examples.zh: 这条路很弯，开车要小心。
examples.en: This road is very winding; be careful when driving.

examples.zh: 前面有一个弯，请慢一点。
examples.en: There's a bend ahead; please slow down.

examples.zh: 他弯下腰，看地上的书。
examples.en: He bent down and looked at the book on the floor.

note: 没有疑问 = no doubt; 提出疑问 = raise a question.

examples.zh: 如果你有疑问，可以问我。
examples.en: If you have any questions, you can ask me.

examples.zh: 对这个结果，我没有疑问。
examples.en: I have no doubts about this result.

examples.zh: 他对医生的话有疑问。
examples.en: He has doubts about what the doctor said.

meaning: to maintain, keep in good order; to defend (rights)

senses.en: to maintain, keep in good order; to defend (rights)

note: 维护 covers upkeep (设备) and protecting rights (权利).

examples.zh: 工人正在维护这条路。
examples.en: Workers are maintaining this road.

examples.zh: 我们要维护自己的权利。
examples.en: We must defend our own rights.

examples.zh: 大家都应该维护环境。
examples.en: Everyone should look after the environment.

note: Can be kind (a child's innocence) or critical (you're naive).

examples.zh: 那个孩子很天真，什么都相信。
examples.en: That child is so innocent and believes everything.

examples.zh: 你别太天真了，他不会帮你的。
examples.en: Don't be so naive; he won't help you.

examples.zh: 她还是那么天真。
examples.en: She is still so innocent.

meaning: to apply, make use of (knowledge, skills, methods)

senses.en: to apply, make use of (knowledge, skills, methods)

note: Typical objects: 知识, 方法, 技术.

examples.zh: 他能把学过的知识运用到工作中。
examples.en: He can apply what he has learned to his work.

examples.zh: 你要学会运用这个方法。
examples.en: You need to learn to use this method.

examples.zh: 这些词怎么运用？
examples.en: How are these words used?

meaning: not have enough time (to do something)

senses.en: not have enough time (to do something)

note: Opposite of 来得及; 来不及 + verb, e.g. 来不及吃饭.

examples.zh: 快点，再不走就来不及了。
examples.en: Hurry up, if we don't leave now there won't be time.

examples.zh: 我来不及吃早饭，就出门了。
examples.en: I didn't have time for breakfast and went out.

examples.zh: 现在去买票，来不及吗？
examples.en: Is it too late to buy tickets now?

meaning: to sponsor; to provide financial support

senses.en: to sponsor; to provide financial support

examples.zh: 这家公司赞助了这次比赛。
examples.en: This company sponsored the competition.

examples.zh: 他们赞助学生去国外学习。
examples.en: They sponsor students to study abroad.

examples.zh: 谁赞助了你们的活动？
examples.en: Who sponsored your event?

note: 工程师 = engineer; 工程 is a project, not the field itself.

examples.zh: 这个工程要做两年。
examples.en: This project will take two years.

examples.zh: 他在一个大工程里工作。
examples.en: He works on a large construction project.

examples.zh: 新工程什么时候开始？
examples.en: When does the new project start?

examples.zh: 她拿到了一笔奖学金。
examples.en: She got a scholarship.

examples.zh: 你想申请奖学金吗？
examples.en: Do you want to apply for a scholarship?

examples.zh: 他靠奖学金读完了大学。
examples.en: He finished university on a scholarship.

note: Used in announcements; in speech people say 火车.

examples.zh: 去上海的列车马上就要出发。
examples.en: The train to Shanghai is about to depart.

examples.zh: 请坐列车的旅客拿好行李。
examples.en: Passengers taking the train, please keep your luggage with you.

examples.zh: 今天的列车晚点了。
examples.en: Today's train is delayed.

note: Followed by adjectives; a bit formal: 极其重要.

examples.zh: 这件事极其重要。
examples.en: This matter is extremely important.

examples.zh: 今天的天气极其热。
examples.en: Today's weather is extremely hot.

examples.zh: 这里的冬天极其冷。
examples.en: Winters here are extremely cold.

note: Formal, used in descriptions: 位于 + place.

examples.zh: 这家医院位于城市中心。
examples.en: This hospital is located in the city center.

examples.zh: 我们的学校位于河旁边。
examples.en: Our school is located next to the river.

examples.zh: 这个城市位于中国南方。
examples.en: This city is located in southern China.

note: Opposite of 窄; 宽 describes width, as in 路宽.

examples.zh: 这条路很宽，车很多。
examples.en: This road is wide and there are many cars.

examples.zh: 我想买一条宽一点的裤子。
examples.en: I want to buy a looser pair of trousers.

examples.zh: 这个房间不太宽。
examples.en: This room isn't very spacious.

note: Notices say 禁止吸烟; in speech also 抽烟.

examples.zh: 这里不能吸烟。
examples.en: You can't smoke here.

examples.zh: 医生让他别吸烟了。
examples.en: The doctor told him to stop smoking.

examples.zh: 请问，这里可以吸烟吗？
examples.en: Excuse me, may I smoke here?

note: 扫地 = sweep the floor; 扫码 = scan a QR code.

examples.zh: 周末我在家扫地。
examples.en: On weekends I sweep the floor at home.

examples.zh: 你扫地，我洗碗，好不好？
examples.en: You sweep the floor and I'll wash the dishes, okay?

examples.zh: 你帮我把房间扫一扫吧。
examples.en: Please sweep the room for me.

note: Marks a result opposite to what you'd expect.

examples.zh: 他吃了药，反而更难受了。
examples.en: He took medicine and instead felt worse.

examples.zh: 我想帮他，他反而生气了。
examples.en: I wanted to help him, but he got angry instead.

examples.zh: 下雨了，路上的人反而更多了。
examples.en: It rained, yet there were even more people on the road.

examples.zh: 我的童年是在农村过的。
examples.en: I spent my childhood in the countryside.

examples.zh: 你的童年快乐吗？
examples.en: Was your childhood happy?

examples.zh: 这些照片让我想起童年。
examples.en: These photos remind me of my childhood.

meaning: to fold; to break/snap; to discount (as in 打折)

senses.en: to fold; to break/snap; to discount (as in 打折)

note: 打折 = discount; 折 as a verb: fold paper, clothes.

examples.zh: 他把衣服折好放进箱子。
examples.en: He folded the clothes and put them in the suitcase.

examples.zh: 她会用纸折小动物。
examples.en: She can fold little animals out of paper.

examples.zh: 你能把这张纸折一下吗？
examples.en: Could you fold this sheet of paper?

note: Opposite of 细; 粗心 = careless.

examples.zh: 这棵树很粗，有一百年了。
examples.en: This tree is thick; it's a hundred years old.

examples.zh: 他的手又大又粗。
examples.en: His hands are big and rough.

examples.zh: 请用粗一点的笔写。
examples.en: Please write with a thicker pen.
